title: Special Cohen--Macaulay sheaves on partial resolutions of rational surfaces singularities
summary: We introduce the categories $\CM(X)$ and $\SCM(X)$ of reflexive sheaves on a minimal partial resolution $f\colon X \to \Spec R$ of a rational surface singularity $\Spec R$. The main result of this paper establishes that $\SCM(X)$ possesses a natural Frobenius structure, serving as a geometric counterpart to the algebraic Frobenius structure on special Cohen--Macaulay $R$-modules, introduced by Iyama--Wemyss and Iyama--Kalck--Wemyss--Yang.
